property_summary: For any fuzzed address newOwner, after calling transferOwnership(newOwner) (from the deployer/owner), owner() must return exactly newOwner; the mutant returns address(0) when _owner==address(0) causing the property to fail when newOwner == address(0).
change_summary: Change owner() to return the hardcoded zero address when _owner is zero, otherwise return stored _owner (adds conditional observable change when owner set to non-zero).
